page_title: PSG 1-1 REI | PSG v Reims 25/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' PSG have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+4' PSG can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90+3' Substitution. Junya Ito leaves the pitch and is replaced by Sekine Hiroki (Reims).
90+2' Booking. Bradley Barcola (PSG) receives a caution from the referee.
90+2' Vitinha (PSG) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
90+1' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to PSG.
90+1' Desire Doue (PSG) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
89' The linesman makes the right call and PSG will have a corner.
89' Senny Mayulu (PSG) smashes a first-time shot a goal from inside the box, but it's bravely blocked by a defender.
87' A cross from a corner kick by PSG is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
86' Yehvann Diouf stretches to his left and makes a brilliant save! Nuno Mendes (PSG) met a rebound outside the box and attempted to beat the keeper inside the right post.
86' PSG fail to score from a corner as Yehvann Diouf (Reims) leaps to collect the ball.
85' Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem shows the yellow card to Mamadou Diakhon (Reims) for a heavy challenge.
85' Flag up against Bradley Barcola (PSG). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
83' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Marco Asensio (PSG) comes onto the pitch so that Khvicha Kvaratskhelia can be given a rest.
83' Bradley Barcola (PSG) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
78' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Bradley Barcola (PSG) but poses no threat.
77' Keito Nakamura (Reims) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
73' Luis Enrique has decided to substitute Goncalo Ramos and he is replaced by Senny Mayulu (PSG).
68' Here comes a substitution. John Joe Patrick Finn is given a rest as he is replaced by Nhoa Sangui (Reims).
65' We are about to witness a substitution. Mamadou Diakhon (Reims) is replacing Oumar Diakite.
64' Teddy Teuma (Reims) is being substituted because of an injury. Luka Elsner sends Amine Salama on the pitch.
60' The substitution has been made. Bradley Barcola (PSG) has replaced Ousmane Dembele.
60' Luis Enrique prepares a substitution. Kang-In Lee is replaced by Vitinha (PSG).
60' The referee signals a substitution. Willian Pacho (PSG) is brought on as a substitute for Lucas Hernandez.
59' The game is interrupted as Junya Ito (Reims) is flagged offside.

56' 1 - 1 GOAL! Marshall Munetsi finds himself with the ball at his feet in space after a lightning counter attack. He looks and up slides the ball to Keito Nakamura (Reims), who coolly slots the ball past the keeper from close in. It’s 1:1.
56' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) hammers the ball towards the bottom left corner, but it's not so easy to put it behind Yehvann Diouf, who denies him with a terrific save.
55' Teddy Teuma (Reims) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards wide of the left post.
52' Junya Ito (Reims) times his run well and connects with a cross on the edge of the six-yard box, but can't keep the ball down and it flies high over the bar.
47' 1 - 0 Goal! Khvicha Kvaratskhelia plays it to Ousmane Dembele (PSG), whose deflected shot from inside the box goes past the helpless Yehvann Diouf. 1:0.
46' The whistle blows and Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem starts the second half.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
42' The attempt by Keito Nakamura (Reims) isn't very precise and Gianluigi Donnarumma stops it with ease.
40' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
37' Kang-In Lee (PSG) was in a good shooting position just outside the box and unleashed a first-time shot towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper made a decent save to thwart his effort.
35' Lucas Hernandez (PSG) infringed the rules and goes into the book. Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem pulls out a yellow card.

32' A wonderful opportunity! Goncalo Ramos (PSG) strikes from close range and hits the ball nicely towards the left side of the goal. However, Yehvann Diouf makes a great save as he anticipates the shot and manages to parry it onto the post.
31' Keito Nakamura (Reims) cracked a first-time shot, but the goalkeeper pulled off an amazing save.
30' That's an easy save for Gianluigi Donnarumma, following a first time shot towards the middle of the goal from Keito Nakamura (Reims).
29' Goncalo Ramos (PSG) outbattles the defender to win the ball from the corner, but he can't quite control his header and sends it just over the bar.
29' The ball goes out of play. PSG are awarded a corner kick.
28' Kang-In Lee (PSG) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.
28' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
27' The goalkeeper pulls off a great save to deny Goncalo Ramos (PSG), whose effort would probably have ended inside the left post.
26' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Junya Ito (Reims).
22' Desire Doue (PSG) goes for goal, but slices it wide of the target.
19' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Oumar Diakite (Reims) heads on.
18' Kang-In Lee (PSG) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
15' The goalkeeper dives to deny Ousmane Dembele (PSG), whose promising shot was aimed towards the left post.
13' Nuno Mendes (PSG) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem signals.
11' A player from PSG commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
10' PSG have been awarded a corner kick.
5' A corner kick by Reims is thwarted by the well prepared Gianluigi Donnarumma (PSG).
4' Sergio Akieme (Reims) is the one who receives a yellow card.
3' Junya Ito (Reims) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Reims force a corner. They send men into the box.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Reims will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem.
